note: The page's Lab tab. Matt 2026-11-12: EVERYTHING being tested is listed here, and a tile opens to its picks. Each entry's numbers come live from its summary file (path relative to data/). Remove an entry when its test is closed or goes live.

tests.title: Pinnacle as the price judge
tests.rule: Hard Rock's price is 2%+ better than Pinnacle's fair price on the same line. Tracked on paper only, never the Record or Discord.
tests.gate: Live only at 150 graded, units up, and when Matt says go.

tests.title: 3-pointers: Hard Rock 1%+ over Pinnacle
tests.rule: 3-pointers only. Hard Rock's price is 1%+ better than Pinnacle's fair price on the same line, no Pinnacle move needed. Tracked on paper only.
tests.discovery: 18 nights before tracking: 17 bets 10-7 +6.15u, beat the close by 0.9%.
tests.gate: Live only at 150 graded, units up and beating the close.

tests.title: Large unders (4+ pt move, under side)
tests.rule: Filter on the live rule's Pinnacle-move picks: Pinnacle move >= 4 pts AND side = under. Counting from Nov 10.
tests.gate: Passes only at 150 graded, profit and beating the close.

tests.title: Late + large (last 90 min, move 3+ pts)
tests.rule: Filter on the live rule's Pinnacle-move picks: window is 90->45 or 45->20 AND move >= 3 pts. Counting from Nov 10.
tests.gate: Passes only at 150 graded, profit and beating the close.

tests.title: Solo + late (solo Pinnacle, last 90 min)
tests.rule: Filter on the live rule's Pinnacle-move picks: others < 1 pt AND window is 90->45 or 45->20. Counting from Nov 10.
